messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — onboarding partner 'CloudFab' sent us an updated usage payload that aggregates by session_id instead of per-request. We just saw a spike in reported "tokens_used" and it's double-counting in EU.
maria: ugh. do we have an example payload? can we map session -> requests? :thinking_face:
sam: here's a redacted sample they sent:

```
{
  "partner_id": "cloudfab-23",
  "session_id": "s-abc123",
  "start": "2026-03-20T12:00:00Z",
  "end": "2026-03-20T12:40:00Z",
  "tokens_used": 12000,
  "sku": "cf-pro"
}
```

sam: they are sending total tokens per session, but our pricing + entitlements are per-inference-call/ per-token slices. so a 40m session looks like 12k tokens in one row.
june: OK. does CloudFab have request-level detail we can ask for? session-level is cheaper to transmit but loses granularity for SKU mapping and region allocation.
alex: they said network constraints. short-term we can apply a heuristic: split session tokens across expected avg tokens-per-call by SKU. not ideal but reduces immediate double-billing.
maria: that heuristic worries me for reconciliation and chargebacks. we need deterministic mapping and auditability.
billing-bot: ingest-error partner=cloudfab-23 event=missing_region field=region severity=warn
ops_lead: adding region missing too — most of those sessions are from eu-central. if we guess wrong region we misattribute credits and taxes.
sam: proposal:
- short term (hotfix): ingestion layer creates synthetic call rows from session payload by splitting tokens into N calls using sku_default_avg_tokens map. tag synthetic=true for downstream audits.
- medium term: change partner contract/schema to include either request_list or call_count + region breakdown + optional per-call timestamps.
- long term: add a compatibility flag in partner profiles so ingestion knows whether to accept aggregated sessions or require per-call granularity.
june: +1. also add an ingestion metric: fraction_of_tokens_marked_synthetic and reconciliation delta per-partner.
alex: timeline: hotfix deployed by EOD tomorrow to avoid weekend billing spikes. contractual schema change tracked in partner-contracts repo, action item for AE to sign off this week.
maria: action items for this thread:
- @sam: implement hotfix mapping + synthetic tagging (PR + test) — due 2026-03-25
- @june: add synthetic_token metric to billing dashboard and alert if >5% for any partner — due 2026-03-26
- @alex: schedule partner call to require region + call_count fields and share reconciliation concerns — scheduled 2026-03-24 @10am PT
- @ops_lead: update reconciliation playbook with steps to reverse synthetic mappings if partner provides retroactive call-level data — due 2026-03-27

maria: also can we add a quick SQL snippet for ops to use when auditing? example below:

```
SELECT partner_id, session_id,
  SUM(case when synthetic='t' then tokens else 0 end) as synthetic_tokens,
  SUM(tokens) as total_tokens
FROM billing_events
WHERE partner_id='cloudfab-23' AND created_at >= '2026-03-20'
GROUP BY partner_id, session_id;
```

sam: I'll open the PR and include a small end-to-end test that validates totals match if partner later provides per-call data.
alex: thanks all. tagged the AE @maria to push contract change. if anyone sees anomalous tax lines in EU invoices this week, ping me directly. :pray:
billing-bot: deploy-hook: ingestion-service hotfix build=2026.03.24-rc5 started
june: nice — can we also include a note in the console 'Partner usage shape heuristic applied' with a link to docs for customers? helps transparency.
alex: yes, add a short entry in the partner docs and a console banner mentioning synthetic count for 48h after fix.
maria: cool. keeping this thread open for updates. will post PR link when ready.
